meta.name: AGV layout-reference design language
meta.purpose: Styling reference for drawing new layout sheets that match documentation/layout-reference.

how_to_read.values: Every value is taken from the source files. Units are px on the 1920x1080 canvas unless stated.
how_to_read.canonical: Where sheets differ, 'canonical' is the value most sheets use, or the sheet family's own value; this is an editorial choice by the extractor, not a rule stated in the sources. Differences are listed in 'variants' or 'inconsistencies'.
how_to_read.new_sheets: Start from the 'presentation' family and these tokens unless the sheet is an installer sheet, a CAD projection or a map overlay.

principles.detail: Light only (color-scheme: light), flat fills, square corners, no shadows or gradients inside the drawing. The only shadow is on the on-screen stage; the only gradient is the speed-ramp band, where it carries meaning.

principles.rule: One restrained palette with semantic accents
principles.detail: Cool grey ink and navy carry the drawing. Magenta marks physical items on the floor. Amber and green carry speed or verdict state. Red is for faults and limits.
The sheet is a captured image; the toolbar is never captured. simple-reference.html keeps meanings on the slide that hosts it, while other sheets carry their rules on the drawing.

principles.rule: Say what is true about the geometry
principles.detail: Each sheet states its scale ('to scale 1 mm = 2 px', 'corner view not to scale', 'trunk length not to scale'), marks indicative positions as such, and uses a break symbol for a shortened dimension.

principles.rule: Wide wash under a thin line
principles.detail: A route is a 56 px pale band carrying state, under a 7 px centreline carrying the path.
Archivo for headings and numbers in badges, IBM Plex Mono for drawing labels and dimensions, IBM Plex Sans for sentences and legends.

presentation.use_for: Engineering layout sheets and slide images.
presentation.structure: Framed panel with the drawing inside, one-row legend strip below the frame. Most sheets also put a title and placement rules inside the frame; simple-reference has neither, because its slide carries them.

dense_engineering.use_for: Sheets that hold a lot of information: route sequences, code matrices.
dense_engineering.structure: No outer frame, title top-left at x 60, content in panels or a tile grid. Type is smaller than the presentation family.

installer.use_for: Instructions for the helper laying tape or markers on the floor.
installer.structure: Same language with larger numbers and darker dimension lines. Indonesian text, millimetres only, where things go and nothing about how the vehicle uses them. Legend is a framed bottom panel.

cad_projection.use_for: Dimensioned plan of the tape in floor millimetres.
cad_projection.structure: Separate token set. World units are mm, on a white ground with a 500/1000 mm grid. System fonts. See 'cad_projection_style'.

map_overlay.use_for: Route, marks and stations drawn on the survey occupancy map.
map_overlay.structure: Pillow raster with the map blended toward white, saturated route colours and DejaVu fonts with a white halo. See 'map_overlay_style'.

core_tokens.description: Declared in :root on all nine HTML sheets with identical values.

--paper.use: Page behind the stage; not captured

--ink.use: Headings, key text, ticks, installer dimensions

--ink-3.use: Tertiary text, extension lines, inactive symbols

--tag.use: Physical floor items: RFID tags, marker strips, stops; focus outline

--agv.use: Vehicle body, track tape on the code sheets, pressed toggle

state_tokens.description: Declared only on the sheets that need them.

--slow-wash.use: NORMAL, slow or creep speed band

--slow-ink.use: Text on or about slow zones

--fast-ink.use: Text on or about HIGH zones and OK verdicts

--tape.use: Tape present but not on this route

fixed_values.description: Literals with no token, used repeatedly or for one defined job.

frame_stroke.use: Outer frame and bottom legend panel border

tape_body.use: Track tape on the engineering sheets

panel_fill_cool.use: Legend and sequence panels on c-mru-route

heading.use: Titles, section heads, badge and code numbers

label.stack: "IBM Plex Mono", Consolas, "Courier New", ui-monospace, monospace
label.use: Default for all SVG text in the drawing; labels, dimensions, toolbar controls

body.stack: "IBM Plex Sans", Calibri, Arial, Helvetica, sans-serif

office_fallbacks.use_for: PowerPoint, Word or Excel, and any render where the web fonts are not available. Archivo and IBM Plex are not Office fonts.
office_fallbacks.weights: Office fonts offer regular and bold only: use bold for 600 and 700, regular for 500.

heading.note: Check long titles for fit; this one is not chosen to be narrower.

label.note: Consolas advances 0.55 em against 0.6 em for Plex Mono, so text runs about 8% shorter and won't overflow. Courier New matches the 0.6 em but looks much lighter.

body.note: Calibri is narrower and looks smaller at the same size, so go up one size step if it reads small. Keeping it distinct from Arial preserves the three type voices.

office_fallbacks.scope: Existing sheets still declare their original stacks; they were not changed.

font_load.note: This is the fuller form used by two sheets; seven sheets omit Plex Sans 700. See inconsistencies.

head.note: Also used inline at 30 px for straight names such as S1 and S2.

minimum_size.reason: simple-reference.html is shown at about 0.47 scale, so its comment requires all text to be at least 26 px.
minimum_size.note: That rule is stated for simple-reference only. Dense sheets go much lower, down to 12 px for sensor edge labels.

not_laid.sheet: none since 2026-11-07, all tape is laid; kept for future sheets

dimension_break.use: White gap cut through a broken dimension

legend_strip.display: flex, align center, space-between, no wrap

inset_panel.title: Subhead at top left, stating view and scale

screen_shell.fit: Scale the canvas with a transform to min(viewport width - 32, 1920); transform-origin top left

toolbar.container: Sticky top, flex wrap, gap 10, padding 10px 16px, --surface, border-bottom 2px solid --ink
toolbar.name: Archivo 700 15 px
toolbar.segmented_control: Border 1.5px solid --ink; buttons padding 7px 12px with 1px --rule dividers; pressed state --agv with white text
toolbar.primary_button: --route fill, white text, border 1.5px solid --route-dark; disabled opacity .6

agv.shape: Block with a white triangle pointing along the heading
agv.plan_size: Polygon about 76 x 44 with a tapered nose, or a 64 x 48 rectangle with rx 4 in mru-straight-test-layout

north_arrow.label: N in label type
north_arrow.note: N is the site-plan north with the MRU line on top, not true north, and the sheet says so.

scale_bar.note: State what it applies to, for example 'HOME complex only'.

status_tile.header_text: White Archivo code number, mono detail lines

legend_swatches.route: Line 62 long: wash 30 wide, --route 5 wide on top, optional chevron
legend_swatches.symbols: The same symbol at swatch size, on 64 x 40

content_conventions.separator: Middle dot with spaces: 'MRU line at MRU4 · Stage 1 · No RFID'
content_conventions.flow_arrow: → for sequence and consequence: 'tape lost → stop, pivot CW'
content_conventions.case: Titles and heads uppercase through CSS text-transform; labels as written
content_conventions.rule_line_pattern: Bold key, two spaces, then clauses separated by ' · '
content_conventions.numbers: Use ≥ and ≤ for limits, ≈ for derived values, ~ for estimates; × in sizes such as '15 × 100'

units.engineering: Metres on the drawing; mm in details
units.cad: mm, with ~ for an estimated dimension and * as used on the projection

content_conventions.provenance: The CSS comment at the top of each sheet records the sheet it follows, its scale, its sources and any dated operator decisions.

export.before_capture: await document.fonts.ready; render with transform none

fonts.halo: Stroke 3, white, on every label over the map

symbols.junction: Circle, r 7 in g1, r 9 in g4, black outline
symbols.station_g4: Square, half-width 8; home half-width 12, black outline

legend.g1: White box with black outline, plus a scale bar of 1, 2, 5 or 10 m
legend.g4: Halo text rows bottom-left with no box; title top-left

inconsistencies.issue: Route direction colours are inverted between families
inconsistencies.detail: c-mru-route draws outbound in orange-red (#c2410c) and return in navy (#1f3f7a). The map overlays draw outbound in blue (#1e5adc) and inbound in orange (#eb7814). The same circuit therefore reverses meaning between sheets.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Use the c-mru-route meaning everywhere, and change OUT/BACK colours when draw_g4.py is next run.

inconsistencies.detail: Magenta --tag on placement sheets, navy --route on mls-marker-codes-standard, mls-marker-codes-1-3 and mls-corner-marker-install.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Use --tag where strips sit beside other route objects. Navy reads well against the dark track on close-up code sheets, so keep it there only.

inconsistencies.detail: #2b3a55 on engineering sheets, #23272f on code and installer sheets, #b7bfcc on c-mru-route for tape off the route, #16181b in the projection.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Use #2b3a55 for tape drawn to scale, and #b7bfcc only for tape that is off the route.

inconsistencies.detail: --out means outbound pass in c-mru-route; --est means estimated dimension in the projection.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Acceptable while the families stay separate; don't put dimensions in this colour on route sheets.

inconsistencies.issue: Plex Sans 700 is used without being loaded
inconsistencies.detail: Seven sheets load Plex Sans at 500 only. Of those, mls-zone-marker-placement, mru-straight-test-layout and c-mru-route use weight 700 in tspan.k, and mls-marker-codes-standard uses it in .verdict, so the browser synthesises the bold. The bold keys on the exported PNGs show this.
inconsistencies.recommendation: Use the font URL in typography.font_load on new sheets, and on these four when they are next edited.

inconsistencies.detail: .sub is Archivo uppercase on some sheets, Plex Sans on c-mru-route and Plex Mono on the code sheets. .tape is a fill on some sheets and a stroke on c-mru-route. .strip and .tick also change colour between sheets.
inconsistencies.recommendation: CSS is local to each sheet, so nothing breaks, but don't copy a class between sheets without checking it.

inconsistencies.issue: Core tokens are copied, not shared
inconsistencies.detail: Each sheet declares its own :root. Core values currently match on all nine, but several sheets also hard-code the same values as literals in SVG attributes, so a token change won't reach them.
inconsistencies.recommendation: No change needed for existing sheets; prefer classes and var() in new ones.

inconsistencies.issue: Document language is wrong on one installer sheet
inconsistencies.detail: mls-corner-marker-install.html has Indonesian text but <html lang="en">; mls-marker-codes-1-3.html correctly has lang="id".
